name: Changeling Omnitype Tribal
summary: Every changeling is every creature type, triggering Sliver / Elemental / Dragon / Elf / Wolf / Goblin / Dalek payoffs simultaneously from a single body. Built around tribal commanders with creature-type-payoff effects — especially The Ur-Dragon (Eminence reduces other Dragon spells by {1}, every changeling is a Dragon).
_status_note: Recipe drafted alongside Hidden Legion deck build (DEC-290 Gate 3, 2026-05-20). Recipe queries are unvalidated against canon. Recipe-approval flow not yet run — to be addressed as a follow-up issue. Decks using this archetype tag will produce candidate pools via existing scoring, but recipe-driven sub-recipe surfacing is not yet active until Gate 2/3 approval.

runtime_semantics.color_identity_splice: Append `id<=<deck color identity>` per query at runtime. Most changelings are mono-color or colorless and survive any splice; the every-type-payoff cards (Sliver/Dragon/Elemental lords) are constrained by color so splice matters there.
runtime_semantics.tribe_parameterization: The sub-recipes for type-specific payoffs (sliver_payoffs, dragon_payoffs, elemental_payoffs) are parameterized on a single tribe. For decks targeting a non-Dragon tribal commander, substitute the tribe name in the relevant queries. The changeling_creatures and changeling_enablers sub-recipes are tribe-agnostic.

changeling_creatures.intent: All creatures with the Changeling keyword — they ARE every creature type and trigger every tribal payoff in the deck simultaneously.

canon_recall._note: Canon recall not validated yet — pending Gate 2 approval.

every_type_enablers.intent: Non-changeling permanents that grant every-creature-type to your board (Maskwood Nexus) or produce changeling tokens (Springleaf Parade, Birthing Boughs). Multiply the effective tribal density.
queries: f:commander (o:"every creature type" or o:"shapeshifter creature token with changeling") -t:creature

sliver_payoffs.intent: Slivers that pump or grant abilities to all Slivers — every changeling is a Sliver, so these effects extend to every changeling.
queries: f:commander t:sliver (o:"sliver creatures you control" or o:"slivers you control" or o:"all sliver")

dragon_payoffs.intent: Dragon tribal payoffs — anthem, scaling burn, attack triggers. Apply to every changeling via every-type.
queries: f:commander id<=wubrg (o:"dragon you control" or o:"dragons you control" or o:"another dragon")

elemental_payoffs.intent: Elemental ETB / cast triggers — every changeling is an Elemental.
queries: f:commander id<=wubrg (o:"another elemental" or o:"whenever an elemental" or o:"elemental enters")

elf_mana_payoffs.intent: Elf-count mana dorks — every changeling is an Elf, so these dorks scale with the entire creature board.
queries: f:commander t:creature t:elf (o:"each elf" or o:"for each elf" or o:"elves you control")

tribal_anthems_global.intent: Universal tribal anthems / draw engines that name a creature type — name Dragon (or Shapeshifter) to apply to every changeling + every real Dragon.
queries: f:commander t:artifact (o:"chosen type" or o:"creatures you control of the chosen type")
f:commander t:enchantment (o:"chosen creature type" or o:"creatures you control of the chosen type")

ur_dragon_combo.intent: Specific cards enabling the Snoop+Kiki+Tremors back-door combo line and Patriarch's Bidding recursion.
queries: name:"Conspicuous Snoop" or name:"Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker" or name:"Impact Tremors" or name:"Patriarch's Bidding"

validation_summary._note: Recipe is in pending-approval status. Canon recall not yet validated against Scryfall. Use for archetype tagging on Hidden Legion deck only; recipe-driven sub-recipe surfacing requires Gate 2/3 approval before activation.
